name: bar-panel
description: A panel anchored to an edge, exposing a drag handle for moving it. Also called a toolbar.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Bar surface. Root of the component and host of the actions slot.

anatomy.name: drag-handle
anatomy.description: Grip that moves the bar (Figma Drag handle layer, S2_Gripper icon).

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Row or column of action buttons.

anatomy.name: divider
anatomy.description: Line between groups of actions; horizontal or vertical by orientation.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: The action buttons in the bar.

anatomyReview.notes: Owner decisions (A8, 2026-11-20): explicit root part container; the grip part is drag-handle (4 legacy records said gripper and moved to the new part name, legacy output unchanged). Figma S2 Web Bar panel and toolbar (9952:19120): Drag handle, action buttons, Divider, Slot. Style (primary, secondary), density (5 widths 44 to 72) and the floating shadow are options and styling, not parts; the legacy widths 40/56/72 do not match the Figma densities (gap bead). The registry entry wrongly called this a sub-part shared by color area and color wheel; fixed.
